justification: Both surfaces carry schematic anthropomorphic signs and simple linear motifs, and A includes a prominent disc while B has small round marks, but these are generic correspondences. A is a single monumental frontal figure with a head, headdress and body covered by symmetrical ornaments including a central rosette and banded belt, whereas B is a scattered field of small boat-like crescents with comb-teeth, stick figures and disconnected marks with no dominant figure or symmetry.
